_about: Public-domain Jean-Pierre de Caussade (1675-1751), French Jesuit spiritual director, in English for the Word Hoard: his Abandonment to Divine Providence (L'Abandon a la Providence divine) in two translations: Ella McMahon's, Abandonment, or Absolute Surrender to Divine Providence (New York, 1887), and E. J. Strickland's, Abandonment to Divine Providence (Exeter, 1921). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 80 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

caussade-abandonment-mcmahon: Abandonment, or, Absolute surrender to divine providence (New York, Cincinnati and St. Louis Benziger brothers, 1887), translated by Ella McMahon
caussade-abandonment-strickland: Abandonment to divine providence, edited by J. Ramière, translated by E. J. Strickland (Exeter : Catholic Records Press ; St. Louis : Herder, 1921; imprimatur 7 March 1921)

_excluded.caussade-other: the French texts (1874 and later); everything printed 1930 or later
_excluded.abandonmenttodiv00causuoft: the undated 'Third English Edition' of Strickland's translation; it may have been printed after 1930, so the 1921 first edition is used instead
